name: triceps-pushdown-cable-one-arm-reverse-grip
title: Triceps Pushdown: Cable (One Arm, Reverse Grip)
primer: This exercise isolates the triceps muscles individually.
steps: Place a cable pulley on the highest setting and attach a stirrup handle to the pulley.
Stand facing the weight stack and grasp the handle with an underhand grip.
Keep your back straight, your abs drawn in and your knees slightly bent.
Starting at the top, push your arm down until it is straight, feeling the concentration in your triceps.
Slowly return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your elbow close to your side while performing this exercise.
